create_LlavaImageProcessor: create a LlavaImageProcessor instance with hf_config, server_args, and a HuggingFace processor for LLaVA image tokenization
process_single_image_task: process a single image from URL, bytes, or ImageData with aspect ratio padding or anyres tiling
process_mm_data_async: process a list of image data items asynchronously with aspect ratio handling and return MultimodalProcessorOutput
create_LlavaMultimodalProcessor: create a LlavaMultimodalProcessor wrapper that dispatches to inner processor based on vision_config.model_type
process_precomputed_image_data: process precomputed image dictionaries with inferred image sizes into MultimodalProcessorOutput
